svg.text: Owns the retrieval half of RAG: ingestion, the vector store and the retrieve API. Generation stays in the AI assistant (ADR-010). Dashed = later (user documents).
copies of help docs from Git
Git stays the source of truth
Ingestion workflow (Step Functions + Lambda): steps 1 → 4 per doc; step 2 only for user documents (later)
1. validate scope (system | mine), k, query length
2. embed query → vector search with filter
3. re-check each chunk's scope and owner
4. return text, source path, heading, score
Aurora PostgreSQL · knowledge database (pgvector) · RDS Data API
documents: doc id · scope (system | user) · owner user_id (null for system) · source path · content hash · version
chunks: text · embedding · heading · doc id
Row-Level Security: scope = system OR user_id = current user · only Knowledge's role has grants
embeddings rebuildable from source; treated as sensitive as the text they encode
